section: Treat a live stream as a queue
purpose: Show vision and speech selecting timestamped evidence before language reasoning rather than pretending the model sees all sensor history.
alt: Vision and sensors: capture and timestamp, select evidence, encode selected views, check freshness. Speech and response: buffer audio, stream recognition, assemble aligned evidence, answer or reacquire. The application chooses admission and deadlines.
caption: Figure 3. Two streams share an evidence selection boundary. Independent Latent Light synthesis informed by capture backpressure, timestamped detection and streaming ASR; gating and freshness policy is proposed here.
verification_scope: Actual current-revision native diagram and complete step, detail, note, caption and anchor text inspected; synthesis, not experimental evidence.
review_notes: Current-revision native diagram inspected in desktop/mobile/light/dark and Focus. Complete exported step/detail/note text and numbered cited caption retained; no source artwork reproduced.
